methodology.fx_description: Static 2024 Reference Annual Average Exchange Rates to US Dollars (USD). Sourced from central banks and IMF International Financial Statistics (IFS).
methodology.ppp_description: Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) conversion factor for private consumption from World Bank World Development Indicators (Series PA.NUS.PRVT.PP), 2024 observation extrapolated from the latest ICP 2017/2021 benchmark methodology (measured in domestic currency per international dollar). Reflects domestic household consumption cost parity, not occupational labor cost parity.
methodology.separation_warning: CRITICAL METHODOLOGICAL INVARIANT: Nominal FX conversion reflects external financial exchange value and international capital transfer parity. Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) reflects domestic consumption purchasing equivalence within local price structures. These metrics serve fundamentally different economic functions and MUST NEVER be averaged, blended, or used interchangeably.

GBP.fx_source: Bank of England 2024 Reference Average / IMF IFS

AUD.fx_source: Reserve Bank of Australia 2024 Reference Average / IMF IFS

SGD.fx_source: Monetary Authority of Singapore 2024 Reference Average / SingStat

INR.fx_source: Reserve Bank of India 2024 Reference Average / IMF IFS
